explication: canvas-confetti is a browser-side particle animation library. A page or application calls its confetti API with launch and rendering options; the runtime creates particles, animates them on a canvas, and returns a promise when the animation completes. The README also documents reduced-motion handling and custom path- or text-based shapes. The source excerpt is partial, so internal links are limited to relationships visible in the excerpts or explicitly documented in the README.
